reviewBoundary: Newly authored provisional primary-school text practices. Exact answer evidence and every distractor were checked by the author only; this is not independent teacher review, learner calibration, an official examination or publication approval.

materials.title: Nature Table Leaves 017
materials.text: For the nature table, collect only fallen leaves. Do not pick leaves from plants. Leave insects outside. Dry leaves go in the flat box. Wet leaves go on newspaper first. Write the place you found each leaf on a small card. Wash your hands when you finish.

questions.prompt: A friend starts picking a leaf from a plant. You say, "____"
questions.explanation: A只捡落叶；B摘光、C整株带走均不合限制。

questions.prompt: A friend finds a beetle and wants it for the table. You say, "____"
options: Put it in the flat leaf box.
questions.explanation: B昆虫留外；A装叶盒、C粘卡均非采集要求。

questions.prompt: A friend has a very wet leaf. You say, "____"
options: Close it in the dry-leaf box now.
questions.explanation: C湿叶先报纸；A枕下非位置；B立即入干叶盒不合分流。

questions.prompt: A friend writes only a name on the leaf card. You say, "____"
options: Write where you found the leaf.
Draw a door and hide the card.
questions.explanation: A卡记发现地点；B午餐、C藏卡均不满足来源记录。

questions.prompt: A friend finishes sorting and reaches for a snack. You say, "____"
options: Put the snack in the leaf box.
questions.explanation: B完成后洗手再吃；A叶当食物、C食物入标本盒均非要求。

materials.title: Class Newspaper Delivery 017
materials.text: Our class makes a school paper. Give one copy to each classroom. The office gets two copies. Keep the last copy on our reading shelf. Do not leave papers on the stairs. If a room is locked, give its copy to the office helper. Write a tick on the list after delivery.

questions.prompt: A friend takes three copies to one classroom. You say, "____"
questions.explanation: B每教室一份；A五更超；C全班不给违任务。

questions.prompt: A friend takes only one copy to the office. You say, "____"
questions.explanation: C办公室两份；A零、B十均不符。

questions.prompt: A friend puts the last copy in a bag to take home. You say, "____"
options: Keep it on our reading shelf.
questions.explanation: A最后一份班级阅读架；B楼梯明禁放；C剪标签非保留用途。

questions.prompt: A classroom is locked. Your friend asks what to do. You say, "____"
options: Push the paper under any stair.
Give that copy to the office helper.
questions.explanation: B锁门转办公室帮手；A楼梯禁放；C爬窗未许可。

questions.prompt: A friend marks a tick before taking the paper anywhere. You say, "____"
options: Tick after you deliver the copy.
questions.explanation: C送达后勾；A提前全勾失真；B删单不能记进度。

materials.title: Marble Track Test 017
materials.text: We test a marble track on a tray. Put the marble at the white start line. Let it roll; do not flick it. Catch it in the small cup at the end. Test one marble at a time. The cracked marble stays in the red pot for the teacher. Count all good marbles back into the box.

questions.prompt: A friend puts a marble halfway down the track. You say, "____"
questions.explanation: A规定白线起点；B终杯、C盘外非起点。

questions.prompt: A friend flicks the marble hard. You say, "____"
questions.explanation: B自由滚不弹；A更用力、C扔越盘均违测试方式。

questions.prompt: A friend puts two marbles on the track together. You say, "____"
questions.explanation: C每次一球；A/B同时更多相反。

questions.prompt: A friend finds a cracked marble. You say, "____"
options: Put it in the red pot for the teacher.
Use it in the next test.
Put it with the good marbles.
questions.explanation: A裂球红罐教师处理；B再测、C混好球均不合分流。

questions.prompt: The test ends, and a friend starts to leave. You say, "____"
options: Count the good marbles into the box.
Put the cup in your pocket with the cracked ball.
questions.explanation: B结束好球点数回盒；A散置、C私带裂球非收尾。

materials.title: Wax Line Picture 017
materials.text: In art class, we draw on white paper with a white wax crayon. I think my page is empty because I can hardly see the lines. The teacher gives us blue watercolour. I brush it over the page. A white fish appears in the blue sea. The paint does not cover the wax lines. I add no more crayon. I wait for the paint to dry and show my fish to Dad.

questions.prompt: The class uses a white wax crayon on white paper.
questions.explanation: A正确：white crayon加white paper；B否认材料配色。

questions.prompt: The writer can see every white line clearly at first.
questions.explanation: B正确：can hardly see初难见；A把难见改全清楚。

questions.prompt: Blue paint helps the fish picture appear.
questions.explanation: A正确：刷蓝水彩后white fish appears；B否认显现过程。

questions.prompt: The paint covers all the wax lines blue.
questions.explanation: B正确：does not cover wax lines；A忽略否定。

questions.prompt: The writer waits for the paint to dry before showing Dad.
questions.explanation: A正确：wait dry and show Dad；B否认操作先后。

materials.title: Sock Puppet Voice 017
materials.text: My brother makes a puppet from a clean green sock. He gives it two paper eyes. He speaks in a deep voice for it. Our little cousin is afraid at first. My brother changes to a soft funny voice and makes the puppet wave. Our cousin laughs and waves back. Later, one paper eye falls off. We put it back with glue after the game.

questions.prompt: The puppet is made from a green sock.
questions.explanation: A正确：clean green sock；B否认材料。

questions.prompt: The puppet has three paper eyes.
questions.explanation: B正确：two paper eyes；A把二改三。

questions.prompt: The cousin laughs from the very beginning.
questions.explanation: B正确：起初afraid，后才笑；A把后情绪提前。

questions.prompt: The brother changes the puppet’s voice.
questions.explanation: A正确：deep改soft funny；B否认调整。

questions.prompt: They fix the fallen eye after the game.
questions.explanation: A正确：after game glue back；B否认修复时间。

units.title: 天气、时间与工具的词群

materials.title: Everyday Word Families 017
materials.text: Choose the word that fits the stated group. Each question has one correct answer, and the other words belong to different groups.

questions.prompt: Which word describes weather?
questions.explanation: B foggy有雾的是天气；A枕头、C镜子均为物品。

questions.prompt: Which word names a part of a tree?
questions.explanation: A branch树枝是树的一部分；B篮、C饼干非树部位。

questions.prompt: Which word tells a time of day?
questions.explanation: C afternoon下午是时段；A信封、B山非时间。

questions.prompt: Which word names a tool for measuring length?
questions.explanation: B ruler尺测长度；A毯、C灯笼无此测量用途。

questions.prompt: Which word describes how something tastes?
questions.explanation: A sour酸描述味道；B圆形、C安静分别形状和声况。

units.title: 图书馆电梯暂停时的安排

materials.title: Lift Out Of Service 017
materials.text: The library lift is not working this morning. A notice asks visitors who can use stairs to take the wide staircase on the left. Visitors who need step-free access should speak to staff at the entrance. Staff can bring requested books downstairs and offer a ground-floor reading table. The upstairs group meeting is moved to Room 2 downstairs. A worker will check the lift after lunch. The notice does not promise that it will be ready today.

questions.prompt: What is not working?
questions.explanation: A电梯故障；B全馆灯、C前门未提故障。

questions.prompt: Which stairs are mentioned for visitors who can use them?
options: A narrow stair on the right.
The wide staircase on the left.
questions.explanation: B左侧宽梯；A方向宽度错；C镇外无关。

questions.prompt: What can staff do for someone needing step-free access?
options: Bring books downstairs and offer a table.
questions.explanation: C下楼送书加一楼桌；A强爬、B闭全馆非安排。

questions.prompt: Where is the group meeting moved?
questions.explanation: A楼下2室；B坏梯、C屋顶未安排。

questions.prompt: What is certain about the lift repair?
options: It will definitely finish before noon.
A worker will check after lunch.
questions.explanation: B午后检查明确；A未承诺当天可用更非午前；C永不修复无据。

materials.title: Flower Press Paper Change 017
materials.text: We press fallen leaves between paper sheets. The sheets go inside two flat boards. We put a book on top to keep them flat. After one day, the paper feels damp. The teacher asks us to change it for dry paper, keeping each leaf’s name card with it. One child mixes up two cards. We do not guess which leaf is which. We leave those two names blank until we can check the collection notes.

questions.prompt: The class presses leaves that have fallen.
questions.explanation: A正确：fallen leaves；B否认采集范围。

questions.prompt: The paper stays dry after the first day.
questions.explanation: B正确：after one day damp；A将湿改干。

questions.prompt: Name cards should stay with their leaves when paper is changed.
questions.explanation: A正确：keeping each card with it；B否认配对要求。

questions.prompt: The class guesses the names of the two mixed-up leaves immediately.
questions.explanation: B正确：do not guess，待核记录；A把暂缓核对改立即猜。

questions.prompt: The two uncertain names are left blank for now.
questions.explanation: A正确：leave two names blank until check；B否认暂空处理。

materials.title: Theatre Prop Flower Story 017
materials.text:
During the school play, Lila had to give a paper flower to the old gardener. The flower was missing from the prop table when her scene began. She could not stop the whole play to look for it. She stepped onto the stage with empty hands and said, "I brought you something that cannot be held: a promise to return in spring." The pupil playing the gardener understood and replied, "Then I will keep a place for you."
The scene continued. Backstage, a helper found the flower under a folded cloth. Lila wanted to blame him, but then remembered she had moved the cloth before the show. After the performance, the group made a simple prop list and checked each object before its scene. Their teacher praised the quick response on stage, while reminding them that a good recovery did not remove the need to prepare.

questions.prompt: What problem does Lila face?
questions.explanation: B出场前找不到花；A服装、C演员离校、D观众禁入均无据。

questions.prompt: How does Lila keep the scene going?
options: She leaves the stage without speaking.
She replaces the flower with a spoken promise.
She brings a real tree on stage.
questions.explanation: C改成带来不能握的承诺；A喊观众、B沉默走、D搬树非行动。

questions.prompt: How does the gardener’s actor respond?
options: He follows her new line naturally.
He asks the audience to find the flower.
questions.explanation: A理解并接会留位置话；B/C/D均与scene continued不符。

questions.prompt: Why does Lila pause before blaming the helper?
options: She has forgotten the whole play.
She remembers moving the cloth herself.
questions.explanation: D自己移动布盖住花；A忘全剧、B帮手离开、C处罚要求均未提。

questions.prompt: What does the teacher’s comment suggest?
options: Preparation never matters if actors can invent lines.
A useful recovery and careful preparation are both valuable.
Every lost prop improves a show.
questions.explanation: B赞应变仍需准备；A把补救当免准备；C每次丢失都好夸大；D没禁布。

materials.title: Roof Garden Noise Note 017
materials.text:
Dear Jun,
Our block has opened a roof garden. Residents can visit from eight in the morning until seven in the evening. The benches are popular after dinner, but the flats below can hear chairs scraping. The garden team has added soft pads to the chair legs and asked visitors to lift chairs rather than drag them. The new sign also says "Quiet time after six." This does not close the garden at six. It asks people to keep voices low for the final hour. I went yesterday and read on a bench. A neighbour wanted music, so he used his own headphones.
See you soon,
Ada

questions.prompt: The roof garden closes at six in the evening.
questions.explanation: B正确：七点闭，六点后安静；A把quiet time当close。

questions.prompt: Flats below could hear chairs scraping.
questions.explanation: A正确：flats below hear scraping；B否认噪声来源。

questions.prompt: Visitors are asked to lift rather than drag chairs.
questions.explanation: A正确：lift not drag；B否认新行为要求。

questions.prompt: Quiet time lasts for the final hour of opening.
questions.explanation: A正确：18至19为最后一小时；B否认时间关系。

questions.prompt: The neighbour played music loudly for everyone.
questions.explanation: B正确：用本人headphones；A把私人听变公开大音量。

materials.title: Clockmaker Window Story 017
materials.text:
Every evening, a clockmaker placed a lamp in his shop window before closing. Theo thought it advertised late opening, so one winter evening he knocked after the door had been locked. The clockmaker opened it and smiled. "The lamp is not for customers," he said.
Across the lane, an elderly neighbour walked home from the community hall. The street light at the corner had failed. The lamp showed the narrow step outside her gate. Theo offered to repair every clock in the shop in return for the explanation. The clockmaker laughed and asked instead whether Theo could report the street light to the town office.
A week later, the street light worked again. The shop lamp disappeared from the window. Theo felt a little disappointed; he had liked the warm glow. Then he saw the neighbour cross the lane without slowing to search for the step. He understood that the lamp had been useful because it answered a particular need. It did not have to become a permanent tradition once that need was met.

questions.prompt: What does Theo first think the shop lamp means?
questions.explanation: B误认晚营业广告；A某钟坏、C邻居卖灯、D会堂关门非初想。

questions.prompt: Why is the lamp actually placed in the window?
options: To light a step near the neighbour’s gate.
To replace every light in town.
questions.explanation: C街灯故障需照窄台阶；A藏钟、B吸客、D全镇替灯均不符。

questions.prompt: What useful action does the clockmaker ask Theo to take?
questions.explanation: A报修街灯；B是Theo主动提出未采纳；C购灯、D关邻门非要求。

questions.prompt: Why does the lamp later disappear?
options: The street light has been repaired.
questions.explanation: D街灯修复无需店灯；A偷盗、B搬镇、C不来均无据。

questions.prompt: What does Theo finally understand?
options: Every useful action must become permanent.
A temporary response can end when its purpose is fulfilled.
Customers should ignore all shop signs.
Tradition matters more than a neighbour’s needs.
questions.explanation: B末段明示需要已满足可结束临措；A与不必永久相反；C/D非故事结论。

units.title: 义卖游戏券的捆数记录

materials.title: School Fair Ticket Bundle 017
materials.text:
At the school fair, each game ticket sold separately for two yuan. To speed up sales, volunteers also prepared bundles of five tickets for ten yuan. The price per ticket did not change. One volunteer recorded "20 sales" without saying whether these were single tickets or bundles. The money box held more than forty yuan, which seemed impossible if every sale meant one ticket.
The team checked the remaining bundles and the written cash entries. They reconstructed how many tickets had been sold and added units to the record. For later shifts, the sheet had separate columns for single tickets, bundles and yuan received. The volunteers still counted the cash at each handover; a clearer sheet reduced confusion but did not replace checking the money itself.

questions.prompt: A bundle made each ticket cheaper than buying singly.
questions.explanation: B正确：五张十元每张二元，与单张相同；A把打包当折扣。

questions.prompt: The phrase "20 sales" was unclear about the unit counted.
questions.explanation: A正确：未说明单票或捆；B否认记录歧义。

questions.prompt: More than forty yuan proved someone had stolen money.
questions.explanation: B正确：可能含捆销售，需核数量，并未证明盗窃；A无证定责。

questions.prompt: The revised sheet separated singles, bundles and cash received.
questions.explanation: A正确：三列明确；B否认改进结构。

questions.prompt: Cash was still counted when volunteers changed shifts.
questions.explanation: A正确：still counted each handover；B把清表当免点款。
